entities.summary: Douglas Correia de Souza is a Brazilian volleyball player, former member of the Brazil men's national volleyball team, 2016 Olympic Champion, silver medallist of the 2014 World Championship, gold medallist of the 2019 World Cup, two–time South American Champion. On the club level, he plays for Farma Condé Vôlei.
